name: 15539-longprefill-mixtral8x7b-8gpu
model: mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1, bf16, unquantized -- do not substitute a quantized checkpoint, it is a different setup rather than a cheaper one.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=8, PP=1, DP=1 -- one node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix reuse: 8000 prompt tokens in, 2 output tokens out, both fixed, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, seed 42. Independent random token ids per request, so nothing is shared between two requests.
purpose: A document analysis assistant handling 8000-token submissions with brief replies, four concurrent users, on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit 82f1d6157f8ed36a8eb758e7090331f817351f01 (v0.5.6.post2-406-g82f1d6157f8).
model-path: mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1
tp-size: 8
ep-size: 8

# 8000-token prompts fit in one chunk here; the stock 8192 would split every request.
chunked-prefill-size: 10000

trust-remote-code: true
cuda-graph-max-bs: 8
